_note: lowest_w_power is the w-order of the z-polynomial the coordinate multiplies after z = w-1; a pole row at minor local power n = r + 2a+3b+4k with a+b+k = w-power, so the earliest pole row carrying the coordinate is n = t_power + 2*(lowest w-power). Jacobian bands at t = t_power see it immediately, at w-powers >= lowest_w_power.
